thread:
incident-bot: ALERT: sudden TPM spike for model-family=pavonis-7b detected in us-west-2. 95th latency increasing, sustained 30m. Auto-escalation -> paging oncall.

oncall_jess: saw it. digging in metrics now. paging @sre_raj and @runtime_maya.

sre_raj: on it. overview: request rate up ~3x for pavonis-7b, tail latency up, a subset of hosts showing KV-cache miss storms. looks like a short-request fanout pattern.

runtime_maya: thanks. if KV misses are killing throughput we should sculpt TPM and drop funcall for that family to reduce small-request overhead. propose: reduce TPM by 60% and disable function-calling for pavonis-7b as a temporary mitigation.

prod_oliver: customer impact? any 5xxs or tenant errors flagged? need an ETA before messaging customers.

support_tina: a couple customers reported transient 502s around 03:12 - here's a log excerpt: ```[03:12:04] tenant=acme-corp model=pavonis-7b code=502 upstream_timeout token_len=34```. They say degraded quality, not data loss.

oncall_jess: running quick canary change on control plane now, will apply to one AZ first. command: ```redwoodctl quota update --model pavonis-7b --tpm 1800 --rpm 45 --scope az:us-west-2a```

runtime_maya: also toggling funcall:false for the same scope: ```redwoodctl feature toggle --model pavonis-7b funcall false --scope az:us-west-2a```

sre_raj: watching infra panels. GPU utilization on affected hosts drops ~20% within 2 mins. 95th latency trending down. KV-miss rate reduced on canary hosts.

oncall_jess: rolling to remaining AZs in 2m if no regression. will keep current quota change in place for 30m and reassess. anyone object? :eyes:

prod_oliver: fine from product side. will prep a short customer note if we need to extend mitigation. keep it minimal: "temporary rate limits applied to reduce latency".

support_tina: flagged high-touch customers (acme-corp, beta-shop) and sent heads-up.

sre_raj: after roll we should incrementally restore funcall on AZs with stable metrics; we can also try small RPM bumps if latency stays low to regain capacity.

oncall_jess: rollout complete at 4955554360. incident-bot: please record mitigation: per-model quota change + funcall disable for pavonis-7b, scope=us-west-2, start=4955554360, planned review=4955556160 (30m).

incident-bot: CHANGE_LOG: quota_update by oncall_jess (tpm=1800,rpm=45) scope=us-west-2a..c; feature_toggle funcall=false scope=us-west-2.

runtime_maya: handing off to SRE for follow-up and root-cause. recommend postmortem to include: request distribution analysis (short vs long), KV cache eviction patterns, and any recent model config pushes.

sre_raj: taking postmortem. assigning owner: raj. will schedule 1hr runbook review later today.

oncall_jess: thanks everyone. keeping thread open for any regressions. :thumbsup:
